Remove an installed plugin

Aliases: `uninstall`, `rm`

## Synopsis

```text
Remove an installed plugin from the system.

This will delete the plugin files and remove it from the configuration.
```

```text
finfocus plugin remove <plugin> [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  # Remove a plugin
  finfocus plugin remove opencost

  # Remove but keep in config (for reinstalling later)
  finfocus plugin remove opencost --keep-config

  # Using alias
  finfocus plugin uninstall opencost
```

## Options

```text
  -h, --help[=true|false]          help for remove
      --keep-config[=true|false]   Keep plugin entry in config file
      --plugin-dir string          Custom plugin directory (default: configured)
```
